encounters-v0.2.json:text.The deer turns its head, sweeping the an: The deer swings its great head, and the antlers sweep the air like a falling branch. You see now how it guards its throat, turning to face every rustle. If there's a way in, it's narrow.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.You keep your body low and work toward t: Belly to the ground, you creep to the last of the cover. One more step and you'll be in the open. The deer is still upright, still chewing, and your heart is hammering.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.You leave the deer where it stands. Ther: You back away and leave the deer standing. Your belly complains all the way back.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.You watch the giant deer from a distance: You watch the giant deer until it fades into the trees. A beast like that would have fed you for days, if you'd dared.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.The wolves keep facing your position. Wa: The wolves keep facing you, ears pricked. No way through them looks safe, and there's no telling whether they'll follow if you run.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.The hyena still holds the space around t: The hyena whoops and stands its ground over the carcass. It isn't going anywhere.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.You leave the carcass within the hyena’s: You turn from the carcass and leave it to the hyena's cackling. There's no meat for you, and no help given.
encounters-v0.2.json:text.You take meat from the Highcrag kill. {h: You tear a mouthful from the Highcrag kill. {hunterName} sees you do it, and the look says it plainly: this was not your hunt.

game-screen.js:encounterCost.deer: The search has used your day (Energy −{deerSearchEnergy}). Watching or leaving costs nothing more but brings no food. Going in for the kill costs Energy −{deerCommitEnergy}, and it may fail.
game-screen.js:encounterCost.wolf: If you withdraw, the wolves may still give chase. A warning from wolves won't change how Highcrag sees you.
game-screen.js:encounterCost.finished: You've already helped here; more won't earn anything.
game-screen.js:encounterCost.forecast: Your odds of driving it off look {tier} (fight {stat} against {threat}). {extra} {wound} Backing down earns nothing with Highcrag.
game-screen.js:encounterCost.woundTrue: If you fail, you'll come away with a minor injury.
game-screen.js:encounterCost.woundFalse: Even if you fail, you won't be hurt.

first-season-v0.6.2.json:text.The request has been refused. That answe: The answer is no. {catName} looks at you for a long moment, and whatever {catName} feels about it stays unspoken.
first-season-v0.6.2.json:text.You did not complete a mate bond with {c: The season turned before you and {catName} became mates. What might have been is still unsettled, and tomorrow is another day.
